description.narrative: To deepen understanding of sub sectoral issues and strengthened these groups into viable sector specific collations and advocacy platforms that have capacities to deliver good services and produce in the sector. IDH organized 2 major market convening for all the regions. The 8 southern regions of Ghana formed one cluster called the southern cluster and the remaining 8 northern regions of Ghana formed another cluster called the northern cluster. All various sub-sectors of the horticulture value chains participated in the market convening these included producers, input dealers, processors, off-takers, importers, exporters, market queens, trade associations, service providers, state regulatory agencies, Agric research institutions, Agric consultants, horticulture development partners and many more. The varied groups were broadly classified under 4 main areas that is producers, market, service provider and state agencies. All these sub-groups formed homogenous groups for the break out sessions to discuss sector specific issues per each sector to develop interventions for the specific sector. Each sub-group was led by a seasoned personality of the sector to lead in the sector discussions. The 4 major sub-groupings were producers sub-group, off-takers sub-group, service providers sub-group and state agencies (FDA, GSS, GSA, EPA, MOFA-PPRSD ETC)
